report.math_notes: Checked the argument step by step. Lemma 0 (gcd(m,m') | a-a' implies the classes meet) is proved correctly via Bezout/invertibility of mu modulo mu' after factoring out g; the case mu'=1 is harmless (the congruence on t is vacuous, any t works). Step 1: under the contradiction hypothesis gcd<=2 for all pairs, gcd=1 is excluded by Lemma 0 (1 divides every difference), so all three pairwise gcds equal exactly 2. Step 2: disjointness plus Lemma 0 (contrapositive) gives 2 does not divide a_i - a_j for each pair, i.e. the three residues are pairwise distinct modulo 2. Step 3: pigeonhole on two residues modulo 2 contradicts this. The contradiction is valid, all quantifiers match the target (arbitrary a_i in Z, m_i >= 1, k=3), and no external source is used mathematically. The exact target claim 'main' is established.
